title: Add commit_bead_state field to CommonConfig and YAML loader
description: In src/agent_takt/config.py: (1) add commit_bead_state: bool = True to the CommonConfig dataclass; (2) include commit_bead_state=True in the CommonConfig(...) construction inside default_config(); (3) in the YAML parser block around lines 226-231, read common.get('commit_bead_state', defaults.common.commit_bead_state) and pass it to the CommonConfig constructor.
acceptance_criteria: CommonConfig dataclass has a commit_bead_state: bool = True field
default_config() returns a CommonConfig with commit_bead_state=True
YAML with common.commit_bead_state: false loads to CommonConfig.commit_bead_state == False
YAML without commit_bead_state key loads to CommonConfig.commit_bead_state == True via the default
